name: kavita-bridge-status
displayName: Kavita 漫画/书库(只读, Bearer API key)
description: Phase A 只读扩展:通过 Kavita REST API (127.0.0.1:5000/api)读取漫画/电子书库、健康状态、series 列表。鉴权用 Authorization: Bearer <JWT-api-key>(用户在 Kavita User Settings → API Keys 生成,与 Audiobookshelf 同模式但未抽 SDK — Audiobookshelf 单案例不够 SDK 化阈值)。仅读 /api/Server/ping /api/Library/libraries /api/Series,**绝对不**触碰 /api/Reader/progress /mark-read /mark-unread /series DELETE /Library scan 任何 mutating 接口。0 上传/外传,100% 本地,符合 P3.10b 红线。
author: PrisirAI 官方
